extracted.intended_audience: Organizations, vendors, researchers, and individuals seeking New York State Department of Health grants, contracts, procurements, or other funding opportunities (applicants/bidders, MWBE/SDVOB firms, grant administrators).
extracted.subtask_description: An official NYS Department of Health web directory of current and closed solicitations (RFA/RFP/RFO/RFI/IFB/SOI/RFC), related procurement forms, and additional funding resources used by prospective applicants and bidders to find opportunities and track deadlines/status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Solicitation type listing (RFA / RFP / RFO / IFB / RFI / RFC / SOI)
rubrics_metrics.description: The page groups opportunities by solicitation type: RFO (Request for Offers), RFA (Request for Applications), RFP (Request for Proposals), IFB (Invitation for Bid), RFI (Request for Information), RFC (Request for Comments), and SOI (Solicitation of Interest).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must identify and respond to the correct solicitation type for their desired opportunity; the page provides separate lists/tables for each type and indicates that some categories may have 'currently no active' items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Due Date (submission deadline)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each listed solicitation shows a 'Due Date' (e.g., 'June 11, 2026, by 4:00 PM ET').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Meet the specified date and time (Eastern Time) for submission; opportunities include explicit deadlines or indicate rolling submissions where applicable (e.g., 'Rolling Submissions until September 28, 2028').

rubrics_metrics.name: Date Issued (solicitation issue date)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each solicitation entry includes a 'Date Issued' showing when the RFA/RFP/etc. was published.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the issue date to determine the solicitation timeline and to check for amendments, reissues, or withdrawn notices; some listings also show reissue/round numbers (e.g., 'Round 7').

rubrics_metrics.name: Status indicators (active, withdrawn, cancelled, reissue)
rubrics_metrics.description: Entries can include status notes such as 'Withdrawn', 'Cancelled', 'Reissue', or indicate that there are 'currently no active' requests.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm current status before preparing an application; do not attempt to apply to withdrawn or cancelled solicitations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Forms for RFPs and IFBs
rubrics_metrics.description: A dedicated section lists required forms for RFPs and IFBs, including MWBE Utilization Plans and Waivers (PDF).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete and include the specific forms referenced by the solicitation (e.g., MWBE utilization plans) as part of a compliant submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: MWBE / M/WBE information and requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Links and references for Minority and Women-Owned Business Enterprise (M/WBE) utilization plans, waivers, and related information are provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: M/WBE rules and documentation may be required by solicitations; applicants who are MWBE-certified or who must meet MWBE utilization should follow the provided guidance and forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: SDVOB (Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Business) information
rubrics_metrics.description: Section and links related to SDVOB (Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Business) participation in procurement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SDVOB-certified vendors should consult the SDVOB information and include any required documentation when responding to solicitations that reference SDVOB participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Single Source Procurements
rubrics_metrics.description: A section for Single Source Procurements is listed on the page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Single source procurements have different procedures/eligibility — bidders should review the single source notices to determine applicability and submission requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional Funding / Supplemental support listings
rubrics_metrics.description: An 'Additional Funding' section lists supplemental supports and pilot programs (e.g., 'Supplemental Support to Ryan White Programs', 'NY State of Health Private Pay Home Care Services Pilot Program').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should review additional/supplemental funding items for eligibility and differing application procedures or contact points.

rubrics_metrics.name: Related information and external resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Related links are provided such as New York State Contract Reporter, New York State Register, and Center for Community Health FAQs (e.g., 'Refusal of Funds from Tobacco-related Entities' Requirement FAQs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult these related resources for broader procurement notices, regulatory requirements, and program-specific FAQs that may affect application preparation and compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Closed opportunities archive (Funding Opportunities/Solicitation Periods Closed)
rubrics_metrics.description: A section archives 'Funding Opportunities/Solicitation Periods Closed' grouping past solicitations for reference.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use closed listings to find past solicitations, timelines, and possibly downloadable solicitation documents or to track historical funding patterns; closed status means no new submissions are accepted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Solicitation metadata and identifiers (RFA#/RFP#/C0#####)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each solicitation includes formal identifiers such as RFA numbers (e.g., 'RFA #20781'), RFP numbers (e.g., 'RFP #C043068'), or contract codes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Always reference the solicitation number when communicating with NYSDOH or submitting proposals to ensure materials are associated with the correct opportunity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time zone and submission time convention
rubrics_metrics.description: Deadlines are stated with time and timezone (commonly 'by 4:00 PM ET').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Schedule submissions according to Eastern Time and verify time-of-day cutoff specified by the solicitation to avoid late submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revision/publication date of the page
rubrics_metrics.description: The page shows a revision date ('Revised: February 2026').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check the page revision date to confirm timeliness of the listings and to ensure you are viewing current information; verify solicitation pages for subsequent amendments.
